execution_environment: OpenAI ChatGPT Python sandbox; synthetic mechanism experiment; NOT Ubuntu target and NOT live FRANK
promotion_guard: Results discriminate contract shapes only. They do not count as H1/H2/BASE target acceptance.

RSD_E1_nondeterminism_omission.interpretation: In this deliberately sensitivity-rich toy transition system, complete sealing gives exact replay; leaving any semantically relevant source live almost always breaks replay. This falsifies coarse-log sufficiency inside the model, not in live FRANK.

RSD_E2_dual_identity.construction: same semantic state/outcome; different retry_count/latency/worker execution metadata
RSD_E2_dual_identity.interpretation: Byte/full-trace identity is too strict as the semantic equivalence oracle when execution-only metadata is allowed to vary.

RSD_E3_crash_effect_idempotency.interpretation: An idempotency key/dedupe-capable external boundary makes retry recovery well-defined in the toy state machine.

RSD_E4_nonidempotent_commit_ambiguity.world_B: external effect already applied before crash
RSD_E4_nonidempotent_commit_ambiguity.strategy_retry: correct in A, duplicates effect in B
RSD_E4_nonidempotent_commit_ambiguity.strategy_skip: loses effect in A, correct in B
required_resolution_family: transactional coupling strong enough to remove ambiguity

negative_results: Do not require the entire physical runtime to be deterministic; real concurrency needs separate testing.
Do not use one all-inclusive trace hash as the H1/H2 semantic oracle.
Do not claim exactly-once for arbitrary external side effects from local journaling alone.
Successful replay is not causal/emergence proof without matched interventions.
